findings.failure_mode: The deferred map-engine import has no failure path: a chunk-load failure (flaky network, or a redeploy purging the hashed chunk — a NEW failure mode created by lazy-loading) leaves the headline map permanently blank with no honest error and no recovery that can actually fetch a fresh chunk (opus, sonnet, codex:sol, codex:terra convergent).
Warmup emits real third-party provider traffic on EVERY server boot in every environment, guarded only by an env flag (opus#5; parked).
The 'retry on failure' path is unreachable in production: the only caller is instrumentation.ts at process start, once (opus#4, codex:sol#2; parked).
MATERIALIZED CTEs project columns not read downstream into the work_mem-bound tuplestore; transit mode unmeasured (opus#3, sonnet#4; parked).
The eager maplibre-gl CSS import sits outside the lazy-boundary claim and test; the bundle instrument measures JS only (sonnet#1; parked).
